Title: Aarav's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aarav - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Shalini - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Shalini stands near him.]

Aarav: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aarav puts on his school uniform.]

Aarav: "I'm ready!"

[Aarav eats his breakfast at the table.]

Aarav: "I'm ready!"

[Aarav irons his school shirt.]

Aarav: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Aarav's phone rings and he answers it.]

Aarav: "I'm ready!"

[Aarav types on his laptop.]

Shalini: "Oh wow!"

[Aarav knocks on the door.]

Aarav: "Really?"

[Aarav opens the door and goes out.]

Aarav: "I really enjoyed today."
